_about: Five-tab templates (CLAUDE.md 'Plans' step 5: why, evidence, benefits, unknown, check). For each plan the pipeline keeps every line whose 'when' conditions all hold ('always' always holds), fills the {placeholders}, and joins them; if none holds, the 'fallback' line is used, so no tab is empty. A line with 'repeat': 'sources' is written once per entry of sources[]. 'basis' points at the cited claim behind a line. Tips (CLAUDE.md 'Plans' step 6) are one string each. Every Nepali text was drafted by SI (Claude) on 2026-11-12 and needs native-speaker review before export; each node carries ne_review until a reviewer replaces it with their name and date.

why.en: This is what you grow now.
why.ne: यो तपाईंले अहिले लगाउने बाली हो।

why.en: We compare every other choice with it.
why.ne: हामी अरू हरेक विकल्पलाई यसैसँग दाँज्छौं।

why.en: Your field is empty {bare_days} days a year.
why.ne: तपाईंको खेत वर्षमा {bare_days} दिन खाली हुन्छ।

why.en: {new_crop} can grow in that empty time.
Rains now start about {shift_days_abs} days earlier.
why.ne: वर्षा अहिले करिब {shift_days_abs} दिन चाँडै आउँछ।

why.en: Rains now start about {shift_days_abs} days later.
why.ne: वर्षा अहिले करिब {shift_days_abs} दिन ढिलो आउँछ।

why.en: This plan plants to match the rains.
{legume_crop} feeds the soil for the next crop.
why.ne: {legume_crop}ले अर्को बालीका लागि माटोमा मल थप्छ।

why.en: Stored water in this area is falling.
why.ne: यस क्षेत्रमा जम्मा पानी घट्दै छ।

why.en: It did well when we replayed your field.
why.ne: तपाईंको खेत फेरि चलाएर हेर्दा यो राम्रो देखियो।

evidence.en: We replayed the weather from {year_first} to {year_last}.
Harvest was {harvest} out of 100 on average.

benefits.en: You already know how to grow these.
benefits.ne: यी बाली लगाउन तपाईंलाई पहिले नै आउँछ।

benefits.en: Ground stays covered more of the year.
benefits.ne: वर्षको धेरै समय जमिन ढाकिएको रहन्छ।

benefits.en: Less soil washes away in heavy rain.
benefits.ne: ठूलो पानी पर्दा कम माटो बग्छ।

benefits.en: {legume_crop} adds natural fertilizer to the soil.
Changing crops can keep pests and diseases down.
benefits.ne: बाली फेर्दा कीरा र रोग घट्न सक्छ।
benefits.basis: FAO Conservation Agriculture, 'Species diversification': crop rotation 'prevents the carry-over of crop-specific pests and diseases from one crop to the next' (https://www.fao.org/conservation-agriculture/in-practice/species-diversification/en/, accessed 2026-11-12)

benefits.en: No clear gain over what you do now.

Without extra water, ten dry days end that.
unknown.ne: थप पानी नभए, दस सुक्खा दिनमा त्यो सकिन्छ।

unknown.en: Your water is unknown, so we show both.

unknown.en: Our rain numbers come from space.
unknown.basis: Owner, 2026-11-12, rain plan A: GPM stays the twin's rain; say that the airport station records about a third less, and do not treat the station as the truth (GHCN S-flag 'S', synoptic-derived, may under-record; REVIEW_NOTES H2). data/checks/demo/crosscheck_gpm_ghcn_NP000444540.json: GPM +41.2% against the station over 49 complete months (2015-2022), so the station is 29% lower; the 7a992fe8 scaling check gave x0.66 (34% lower) from 2016. Plan B (Friday): the 4 GPM cells and DHM's published Bhaktapur averages

check.en: Ask your local farm advisor first.
Ask if {new_crop} seed is sold nearby.
Check how much water you really have.
check.ne: तपाईंसँग साँच्चै कति पानी छ, जाँच्नुहोस्।

check.en: Try it on one small part first.

आफ्नो जमिन तपाईंलाई नै राम्रो थाहा छ।

tips.ne: {crop}लाई {month}मा सबैभन्दा धेरै तिर्खा लाग्छ। सक्नुहुन्छ भने त्यतिबेला पानी दिनुहोस्।

tips.en: Cover bare soil with straw in {month}.
tips.basis: crop_explainers.cover claims 1-2 (FAO: residues on the surface reduce splash and runoff)

tips.en: On part {section}, plant across the slope.
tips.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Tips' (contour planting); a sourced slope threshold is still needed (step 8)
